hypotheses.V0_full_rank_recomposes: Full-rank OV reconstruction reproduces the selected program's exact downstream logits to maximum error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.V1_rank4_payload_is_often_sufficient: Four leading OV singular modes per selected head recover at least 0.80 output energy fidelity for at least three families.
hypotheses.V2_payload_programs_are_low_rank: The smallest audited rank reaching 0.90 output fidelity is at most eight per head for at least three families.
hypotheses.V3_weight_outliers_beat_random_modes: At rank four, leading singular modes exceed matched random singular modes by at least 0.20 output fidelity for at least three families.
hypotheses.V4_current_values_not_persistent_bus_dom: Current-value Shapley projection is at least 0.70 for at least three families.
